subject: info-f
title: INF.F.-----RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 375 (R(AS)CM(II)-19). INFO-F (information focus) is the subject; RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the partner. The title names INF-F; the chart has no label for it. From the subject: CULT-INFO-BS (culture information basis), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and AF-NT (affinity nature). From CULT-INFO-BS: ACT (activism). From PROG-CONT: GRAD (gradualism). From AF-NT: CN-INFO (controlled information). From GRAD: STF (source transfer).
